summary.tldr: Tightens detention rules for accused people charged more than twice with certain serious indictable offences while on release or a summons.
what_it_does: Replaces Criminal Code subsection 524(4), which applies when a judge or justice cancels a summons, appearance notice, undertaking or release order.
Requires the accused to be detained in custody unless they show cause why detention is not justified under subsection 515(10).

Adds a special rule for accused people charged more than twice with an indictable offence punishable by five years or more while on release, detention is required unless exceptional circumstances justify release.
summary.background: The bill amends the Criminal Code rule on judicial interim release. It changes the detention rule in subsection 524(4).
